page_title: BAR 6-0 VAL | Barcelona v Valencia 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Guillermo Cuadra has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Valencia was in an offside position.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+1' A cross into the box from Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is cleared.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Dani Olmo (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
89' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
86' Referee Guillermo Cuadra points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes wild in celebration.
86' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Guillermo Cuadra wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
86' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
83' A pass from Thierry Correia (Valencia) is intercepted by Joan Garcia and the move breaks down.
82' Raphinha (Barcelona) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
81' The game has come to an end for Pedri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
81' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
80' A great solo run by Largie Ramazani (Valencia) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Joan Garcia.
77' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Hugo Duro will be replaced by Lucas Beltran (Valencia).
76' 5 - 0 Dani Olmo plays a neat ball into the path of Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who makes room for a shot and sends it towards the top right corner, ricocheting in off the post! 5:0.
74' It's time for a substitution. Jofre Torrents (Barcelona) comes on in place of Gerard Martin.

74' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
73' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
72' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
71' A pass travels right across the box to Luis Rioja (Valencia) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Joan Garcia denies him with a decent save.
70' Thierry Correia (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
70' 17:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
70' Raphinha (Barcelona) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
68' Substitution. Ferran Torres will be replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
68' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Marcus Rashford and he is replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
66' 4 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish!
65' Substitution. Thierry Correia (Valencia) has come on for Mouctar Diakhaby.
62' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
60' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
57' A substitution has been made. Diego Lopez is replaced by Luis Rioja (Valencia).
57' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) replacing Javi Guerra.
57' Here's the change. Arnaut Danjuma leaves the pitch and Largie Ramazani (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.

56' 3 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Julen Agirrezabala just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:0.
53' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Marcus Rashford plays it into the box, and Raphinha (Barcelona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:0.
53' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
52' Barcelona keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
50' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will take a throw-in.
49' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
48' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
46' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is caught offside!
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Raphinha (Barcelona) and Roony Bardghji is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Hugo Duro (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
42' Barcelona try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
41' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
39' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Marc Casado (Barcelona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
38' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
38' The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
38' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Flag up against Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
34' Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
33' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
31' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
31' Good clearance! Diego Lopez (Valencia) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
31' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

29' 1 - 0 Goal! Ferran Torres plays in Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:0.
28' Diego Lopez (Valencia) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
23' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
22' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marc Casado (Barcelona). A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
19' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
19' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) sends a short pass into the box, Ferran Torres takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
19' A spell of possession for Barcelona in an attempt to control the game.

17' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.
16' 7:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.

15' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Julen Agirrezabala guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

14' A neat pass is well received by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
14' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia). Barcelona get a free kick.
12' Pedri (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Julen Agirrezabala, who smothers the ball.
10' Good chance! Pedri laid the ball off to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
8' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
7' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
6' The foul by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

5' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball low towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Julen Agirrezabala with a fabulous save.
5' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
4' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

3' Ambitious effort from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
3' The linesman raises his flag. Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
1' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Barcelona will take a throw-in.
1' Guillermo Cuadra couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Eric Garcia (Barcelona) and blew his whistle. Free kick. Valencia will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Barcelona will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra will supervise the game today.
